en: There you are! Isn't it brilliant? Smoke and gears and stone, and the stadium sat on top of it all.
Registration for the gym challenge is at the stadium. Up the ramp! Let's go and make it official!
Route 3's for challengers, and the challenge doesn't open until after the ceremony. See you on the other side!
Galar Mine No. 2 runs north under the banks to Hulbury, but it's for challengers with the Water Badge. Turffield first!
You're the one Team Yell keep moaning about. Sorry about them. They mean well. Mostly.
I'm Marnie, from Spikemuth. I'm in the challenge to win it, same as you. Let's see if they're right to worry.
Hm. You're tougher than you look. Kabu's gym is up at the stadium. I'll see you there, or after.
